facts.fact: Central Equatoria State's Ministry of Information and Communication, with Scenius Hub, is implementing the five-year DISK Program, whose three Digital Skills Centres in government facilities will train civil servants among others, with renovation works already begun.

facts.fact: The state-level DISK Program, a five-year initiative of Central Equatoria State's Ministry of Information and Communication with Scenius Hub, is establishing three Digital Skills Centres to train youth, women, entrepreneurs and community members in digital literacy and ICT skills, with renovation begun.
